original_title: Paris prosecutor opens investigation into missing uranium in Niger: The Paris prosecutor has opened a probe into organized gang theft, in the interests of a foreign power, after uranium went missing from a site in Niger previously operated by French nuclear fuel group Orano

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: Uranium theft from a former Orano site in Niger, investigated as organized gang theft in the interests of a foreign power. Potential for nuclear proliferation, smuggling, or destabilization. High-value material with dual-use risk (energy/weapons).
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Increased scrutiny on cargo shipments from Niger; possible interdiction attempts by French/Nigerien authorities. No direct threat to aviation or personnel expected in near term.
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: Potential escalation if uranium is weaponized or trafficked to hostile actors. May strain France-Niger relations further. Monitoring for similar incidents at nuclear facilities advised.
ai_analysis.operational_impact: Heightened cargo screening for uranium/radioactive materials; possible delays in regional logistics. No immediate aviation or personnel risks, but theft networks may use transport infrastructure.
